diagram_math_checks.objects: A two-site center J=[k,k+1] in an open-boundary TT; L is the fixed prefix interface, R the suffix interface; each active core G_j has indices (alpha_{j-1},i_j,alpha_j).

diagram_math_checks.objects: Canonical prefix L and suffix R; center embedding E.
diagram_math_checks.check: L has rows i_L and columns alpha_{k-1}; R has rows alpha_{k+1} and columns i_R. Thus E maps center coefficients with shape r_{k-1} x n_k x n_{k+1} x r_{k+1} to full tensor coefficients. L*L=I and RR*=I give E*E=I; the illustration labels the prefix left-isometric and suffix right-isometric.
diagram_math_checks.justification: lem-na-mps-environment-isometry-and-effective-hamiltonian Statement and proof steps 1.1–2.1 explicitly establish those interface identities and the domain/codomain of E; algorithm step 3 invokes that setting.

diagram_math_checks.check: The bracket encloses exactly G_k and G_{k+1}. The forward arrow points right (increasing k); the backward arrow points left (decreasing k). They denote visit order, not linear maps. Width-one interpretation is explicitly separate.
diagram_math_checks.justification: Algorithm step 2 visits sites 1,...,d or pairs 1,...,d-1 in forward order and reverses that order backward; caption identifies the two-site example.

diagram_math_checks.objects: The exact compact SVD X=U Sigma V* and its two factorization rows.
diagram_math_checks.check: Writing X as (r_{k-1}n_k) by (n_{k+1}r_{k+1}), compact rank q gives U of shape (r_{k-1}n_k) by q and V* of shape q by (n_{k+1}r_{k+1}). Forward factors U and Sigma V* multiply to X; backward factors U Sigma and V* also multiply to X. Site labels assign first/second factors to k/k+1, moving Sigma toward the next window without truncation.
diagram_math_checks.justification: Algorithm step 5 states these precise reshapes and absorption conventions and retains every positive singular direction.
